note: Each mutation breaks one property of the real extension. A check that does not go red for its own mutation is not evidence of anything.

mutations.mutation: the service worker stops serialising its handlers
mutations.why: restores the read-modify-write race that used to drop steps arriving in one tick

mutations.mutation: the recorder captures the password it typed
mutations.why: the literal credential would reach the export, the extension storage and the platform

mutations.mutation: recorded test ids drift, and candidates are no longer checked against the page
mutations.why: locators that look plausible but address nothing in a fresh browser

mutations.mutation: the recorder injects a node into the page it is recording
mutations.why: a recorder that modifies the application is recording something the user never had

mutations.mutation: consecutive edits to one field are compared by their serialised form again
mutations.why: the comparison BUG-0006 was about: never true, so every change event became a step
